title: 12.5 Volumes of Pyramids and Cones

icans: I can find the volume of a pyramid.
I can find the volume of a cone.
I can find the volume of a composite solid.

vocab: Height of a pyramid or cone
the ________________ distance from the vertex to the plane of the base
a solid made up of two or more __________

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: how many cones fill the cylinder?

blocks.p: Fill the cone (or pyramid) and pour it into the cylinder (or prism) with the same base and height. Count the pours.

head: Solids used
Pours to fill
Fraction of the cylinder or prism

blocks.p: Volume of a cone or pyramid = ______ × volume of the matching cylinder or prism.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Find the volume of the square pyramid.
A pyramid with a 6-by-4 rectangular base has a volume of 96 cubic feet. Find its height.
Find the volume of the cone. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A cone has a radius of 5 and a slant height of 13. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.

notes: Composite solids: find the volume of each part, then _______________ (or subtract a part that is removed).

blocks.stem: A grain silo is a cylinder with a radius of 3 meters and a height of 10 meters, topped by a cone with a height of 4 meters. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A pyramid has a square base with sides of 9 and a height of 8. Find its volume.
A cone has a diameter of 8 and a height of 9. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.

tickets.stem: A pyramid has a 5-by-6 rectangular base and a height of 4. Find its volume.
A cone has a radius of 6 and a height of 5. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A pyramid has a base area of 50 and a volume of 200. Find its height.
